vetSays.line: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek: "We've got days of stores, not weeks. The treeline is the pantry now. Learn what's out there."
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." Company makes the road shorter.
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +2 clean.
🍲 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek is eating by the fire — not talking, just eating.

"Hey." A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek.)
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek hesitates, then backs off. "Not today. Sorry." (Low trust — reluctant.)
📋 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek — 🪾 Gather deadfall. They'll report back by next part.
🍂 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek gathers deadfall — 1 stick + 1 fiber. The pile grows. (2 sticks now.)
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +2 clean.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek hesitates, then backs off. "Not today. Sorry." (Low trust — reluctant.)
📋 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek — 🪾 Gather deadfall. They'll report back by next part.
You give A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek 3 portions of Dried beans, with the village watching. They look at you differently now.
🍂 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek gathers deadfall — 1 stick. The pile grows. (4 sticks now.)
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek had the day of their life — 1895 kcal. The pantry can't take it all: 948 kcal goes in, 947 kcal is eaten at the fire.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." Company makes the road shorter.
A woman, maybe 30s, with restless hands showed A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek the Wild Ramps — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
📋 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek — 🪾 Gather deadfall. They'll report back by next part.
🍂 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek gathers deadfall — 1 stick. The pile grows. (3 sticks now.)
You catch fragments by the fire — Meera telling A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek about A man, maybe 20s. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +2 clean.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +3 clean.
You catch fragments by the fire — Terrence telling Victor about A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek. Half of it's true anymore. You're not sure which half.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." The pantry won't fill itself.
You catch fragments by the fire — Meera telling A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek about himself. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.

A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. A man, maybe 60s, with freckles is showing everyone big brown-capped mushrooms with thick pale stems and sponge pores, no gills by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The journal grows — the human way.
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +3 clean.

You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 30s, with a shaved head telling A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek about you. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 30s, with restless hands telling A man, maybe 20s about A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek. The story's getting bigger than what happened.
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 30s, with a shaved head telling Naran about A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek. The details have shifted. Nobody seems to mind.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." The pantry won't fill itself.
You catch fragments by the fire — Victor telling A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek about you. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
A woman, maybe 30s, with restless hands sets out to find A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek. "Won't be long." Company makes the road shorter.
You catch fragments by the fire — Marta telling A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek about you. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek is hurt — a fall, a thorn, a bad step. (health 79/100)
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek showed A man, maybe 30s, with a shaved head the Hickory Nuts — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Kieran, Terrence, Victor, Brian and Meera met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Kieran, Terrence, Victor, Brian, Meera are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Yara just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
(Elder Performance Review's hide absorbs 6.)
You STRIKE the Elder Performance Review for 65 (Shard spear).

Elder Performance Review is BLEEDING — and it likes it. Louder, faster, no more feints.
(Elder Performance Review's hide absorbs 6.)

🛡️ Kieran, Marta, Magnus, Eric and Victor met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Kieran, Marta, Eric, Victor are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Naran just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Terrence just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ingrid just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
